spot_price.description: Current underlying price shown on the dashboard

captured_at.description: When the screenshot was taken (client timestamp, not from the image)

expiration.description: The expiration date column being visualized, e.g. 2026-09-18

read_type.description: Which horizon this snapshot is tagged as

levels.description: One entry per strike row, ordered high to low as shown on screen

net_gex_millions.description: Signed value in millions of dollars. Positive = dealer long gamma (green). Negative = dealer short gamma (red).

is_flip_zone.description: True for the strike nearest spot_price where sign changes
